## Pain point and scope

Which hosted API services and review date does this transparency comparison cover?

## Evidence

- [ ] At least two comparable providers and all ten controls are included.
- [ ] Every `documented` control links directly to a public HTTPS source.
- [ ] Every `not_documented` or `not_applicable` result is explained.
- [ ] Affiliation and material conflicts are disclosed.
- [ ] No result is phrased as proof of safety, compliance, theft, fraud, or misconduct.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 rankings.py`
- [ ] `python3 rankings.py --check`
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
